articleTitle: Anomaly Detection in Smart Grids using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Monitoring a smart grid using Information and communication technology tools require mechanisms for detection of anomalies like faults, cyber-attacks, etc. Most of the present power systems are equipped to deal with anomalies caused by faults or other natural disturbances. However, detecting and discriminating anomalies caused by the cyberattack against the power system is yet to be satisfactorily achieved. In this paper, we employ different machine learning techniques to detect power system anomalies. Besides detecting anomalies, machine learning methods can also differentiate between cyberattacks and natural disturbances. We assess several states of the art machine learning techniques in terms of their ability to detect cyber-attacks including those attacks which employ deceptive techniques to hide their foot prints. Evaluation is carried out using a dataset generated by an IEEE 3-bus system, and performances of machine learning techniques are analyzed in terms of accuracy of detection and required processing power.

articleTitle: Sales Forecast for Amazon Sales with Time Series Modeling
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Accurate sales prediction plays an important role in reducing costs and improving customer service levels, especially for B2C(Business to consumer) e-commerce. This paper attempts to forecast future sales at Amazon.com, Inc. based on historical sales data. Firstly, it proposes three possible forecasting approaches according to the historical data pattern, that is Holt-Winters exponential smoothing, neural network auto regression model and ARIMA(Autoregressive integrated moving average). Secondly, it specifies certain accuracy measures using which well determine the suitability of the forecast methods on the available sales data. Finally the three methods will be implemented to forecast Amazons quarterly sales in 2019. The results can help Amazon well manage its future operations.

articleTitle: Leukemia Disease Detection and Classification Using Machine Learning Approaches: A Review
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Leukemia is a type of blood cancer which occurs due to abnormal increase in WBCs (white blood cells) in bone marrow of human body. Leukemia can be classified as acute leukemia and chronic leukemia, in which acute leukemia grows very fast whereas chronic leukemia grows slowly. Further both the types have two sub categories lymphocytic and myeloid. In this paper, we are going to analyze different image processing and machine learning techniques used for classification of leukemia detection and try to focus on merits and limitations of different similar researches to summarize a result which will be helpful for other researchers.

articleTitle: Real Time Object Tracking for Intelligent Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: The density of current road traffic frequently producing circumstances that endanger the protection of individuals. For the safety of individual, one has to keep the safe distance from an upcoming vehicle in a busy road. In an intelligent vehicle system, the selection of sensors, orientation and velocity of persons and other moving objects are significant for logical decisions in a given scenario. These acquired information can be deployed to offer a Driver Assistance System (DAS) for future intelligent vehicle. In the proposed work, vision-based sensors are castoff to follow the targeted object moving in road traffic. A real time data set is prepared for the proposed work to track the object positions for an intelligent vehicle in road traffic.

articleTitle: Multiple UAV Path-Planning for Data Collection in Cluster-based Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: In a multiple UAV-based data collection from the cluster-based wireless sensor network, selection of an optimal set of load-balanced cluster heads and calculation of optimal path for each Unmanned Aerial Vehicles(UAV) are very challenging research issues. Most of the existing cluster head selection schemes do not consider the uniform distribution of cluster heads and also do not consider delay incurs in data collection. Thus, in this paper, the Salp-Swam optimization method is used for the selection of an optimal set of load-balanced Cluster Heads(CHs) and Differential Evolution(DE) based meta-heuristic is used for estimation of delay efficient optimal path for each UAV. In this paper, multiple-UAV is deployed for data collection task in order to reduce data collection time. All UAVs start its journey from the base station, collect data from its cluster heads and return back to the base station. The performance of the proposed scheme is compared with two well-known existing schemes in a different network scenario in terms of travel distance and travel time. Through simulation results, it is observed that the proposed scheme outperforms the existing schemes with respect to the travel time.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of Lung sound denoising technique
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Pulmonary disorders are causing a huge increments in the mortality rate. The main reason behind this is misinterpretation or delay in diagnosis of disease. Developing a computerized system which can help clinicians to remove this problem will give a better result in controlling these adverse effects of increasing mortality rate. Data collection and their preprocessing with the help of computerized system will tend to remove the chances of overlapping of results which may cause misinterpretation. For developing a computerized system. Data from 15 patients have been collected in the time period of one month. Along with the results of pulmonary function test the overlapping are easily visible which can be overcome by including heart sound and lung sound in our analysis. However, lung sound signals are subjected to different kind of noises. Therefore, six denoising techniques are Wavelet, Savitzky Golay Moving average filter, FIR, Median filter and Butterworth filter are implemented and evaluated. The performance of all the three filters are compared on the basis of signal to noise ratio. Wavelet denoising technique gives better result with a Signal to noise (SNR) value of 84.43dB.

articleTitle: Model-Based Collaborative Filtering for Recommender Systems: An Empirical Survey
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Saving time is one of the most important things. A Recommender system certainly saves our time by generating a prediction of things for us from an extensive database that we might like. Due to the widespread use of the internet, it became a popular area of research in the machine learning community. It is being used in almost all web sites these days to keep track, what users want or like so that when they visit next time, it can predict something for them. A lot of research has been done on this field, but still, the performance of these systems is not that good to be accepted by the end-users. Among these, model-based collaborative filtering is widely used in commercial recommender systems due to its scalability and capability of handling sparse datasets. In this paper, we will provide a detailed insight into these techniques along with their advantages as well as disadvantages.

articleTitle: Class Imbalance Deep Learning for Bankruptcy Prediction
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: This paper addresses one of the most burning issues among financiers namely bankruptcy prediction. For Bankruptcy prediction many researchers have used various methods ranging from Statistical Modeling to Machine Learning. Training a robust Machine Learning model to accurately predict whether a company goes bankrupt or not is a challenging issue in the sense that real life data is often imbalanced. Hence, we first reduce the imbalance nature of data and then train a Deep Neural Network with the balanced data. The dataset used is that of Polish companies which consists of five years of data corresponding to five different tasks. We reduce class imbalance using an Oversampling method known as Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE). Our model significantly outperforms the previous neural network models and weak learners trained on this dataset in terms of Area Under Receiver Operator Characteristic Curve (AUC).

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis of 5T SRAM Cell for Low Power and Less Area SRAM Based Cache Memory for IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: The (static random access memory) SRAM cell plays an important role to design a balanced and optimized processor for cache memory. Typically, the primary 6T SRAM cell gives more power loss and delay. To reduce the total power and static power loss, the N-Controlled(NC) and 8T cells are designed. However, due to extra added transistors, the NC and 8T cells consume more area and give less stability. The new 5T SRAM cell has been proposed to overcome these problems. The proposed cell consumes 7.5%, 20.0%, and 20.12% less area in comparison of 6T, NC, and 8T cell, respectively. The total power loss of the proposed 5T cell is decreased by 90.62%, 86.29%, and 84.07% compared to 6T, NC, and 8T, respectively. Similarly, the static power loss of the proposed cell is reduced by 75.78%, 49.07%, and 70.82% compared to 6T, NC, and 8T, respectively. The speed is improved by 50.54%, 48.82%, and 43.87% compared to 6T, NC, and 8T, respectively. The stability of the proposed cell is comparable. The Monte Carlo (MC) simulation with process variations for the proposed cell has been performed to check the deviation.

articleTitle: Analysis of a grid-connected battery energy storage based energy management system
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: The energy cost becomes a significant challenge to the consumer side when the size of the energy demand is of concern and electricity tariff increase in the function of high peak demand for energy consumption. The smart grid through demand response (DR) schemes under energy prices strategy, several prices based demand management methods are being developed. This paper presents a novel approach of reducing the cost of energy from the utility grid (UG) through an energy management system (EMS) of a hybrid UG energy storage system (ESS) based on DR time of use (TOU) electricity tariffs. The scheme aims to optimally coordinate the energy flow in such a way the ESS can be charged during the off-peak period and discharge at no off-peak time. The paper assesses the strategy by using load demand and the price of electricity for the commercial sector. It has been found that the designed model can reduce the yearly energy consumption from the UG of about 50%. Thus, the hybrid UG-ESS model is of an essential satisfaction for both energy supplier and consumer where the energy crises are of concern.

articleTitle: Comparative Assessment of Various Islanding Detection Methods for AC and DC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Distributed energy resources (DERs) are an alternative to conventional fossil fuel-based energy resources for a pollution-free operation. But the integration of these DERs to the main grid comes with certain challenges, out of which islanding detection is of prior importance. This literature provides a review of existing techniques used for islanding detection in AC and DC microgrid along with their advantages and shortcomings.

articleTitle: A Reduce Device Count Nine Level MLI Using Switched Capacitors
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Multilevel inverters are costly when it employs a higher number of dc sources and power semiconductor switches. This paper suggests a topology which uses one dc source, and three self-balanced capacitors and six switches to generate nine-level along with polarity generation using H-bridge. The switching scheme is made in such a manner that capacitors get balanced automatically. The modes of operation and charging and discharging of capacitors is presented with illustrations. The simulation result for this topology is verified on MATLAB 2018a. The simulated results show the output voltage levels, capacitor voltage profile.

articleTitle: Prediction of Specific Language Impairment in Children Using Speech Linear Predictive Coding Coefficients
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Specific language impairment (SLI) is a kind of neurodevelopmental disorders which could disturb the speech production and language comprehension ability of a child. The detection/prediction of SLI in children is done through behavioral analysis and age specific language test scores by speech therapists and child psychologists. Modern computational approaches may chop off the long prediction time to diagnose the disorder and support the child as well as parents to start ministrations early. The present work gives an idea for detection of SLI from children's voice with the help of linear predictive coding coefficients (LPCs) as they have the ability to model human vocal system. Two classifiers: naïve-Bayes (NB) and support vector machine (SVM) were resorted to categorize children in both SLI and healthy groups respectively. The best classification accuracies of 97.9% (for top-20 LPC features) and 97.8% (for top-10 LPC features) were secured by NB classifier for 5-fold cross-validation protocol. The study concluded that LPC parameters play a crucial role in detection of SLI and could be put to uncover other discern neurodevelopmental disorders via children's speech signals.

articleTitle: Fractional Order Parameter Estimation from the Nyquist Plots with Two Distinct Lobes
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Equivalent circuit modelling is an important tool to investigate electrochemical processes. This paper presents an analytical technique for the estimation of model parameters from the frequency response (Nyquist plot) of the system, when the plots have two distinct semicircular lobes. The proposed technique is suitable also for fractional order model as it includes the cases where one of the lobes is a depressed semicircle, originated due to the presence of a constant phase element. This method provides a quick estimation of equivalent parameters, thus, would be helpful for online parameter estimation like state-of charge estimation for a Li-ion battery in electrical vehicles.

articleTitle: Review on General Architecture and Selection of Multiple Input Converters
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: DC-DC converters are the major power electronics interface units that are being widely used in diverse fields. With the increase in demand for renewable energy sources, the demand for converters that integrate these sources led to the transformation to multiple input converters (MICs) from single input converters (SICs) to in the recent past. MICs penetrated into several applications ranging from millivolt to kilovolts and milliwatt to megawatt for effective and efficient integration of sources with different voltage-current characteristics. With the advent increase in MIC topologies, it becomes quite challenging and confusing to select one with desired specifications for a specific application. Depending on the characteristics, MICs have been categorized and each of them possesses both advantages and limitations. The general categorization and comprehensive review based on the characteristics of MIC have been presented in this paper. The idea of the paper is to present a clear picture, general rules and framework of MIC topology for selection with respect to the application. Further, the advantages and limitations of few recently proposed MIC topologies, followed by the selection for different applications are discussed.

articleTitle: Hybrid Order Generalized Integrator based Control for VSC to Improve the PMSG Operation in Isolated Mode
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: This paper presents the Hybrid order means the combination of Second- and Third-Order Generalized Integrator (MS-TOGI) based Control is applied here to operate voltage source converter (VSC) which is used to improve the power quality of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Generator (PMSG). The wind energy driven PMSG is working in isolated mode and supplying power to remotely located linear/nonlinear loads. The use of MSTOGI as a control method is helpful to eliminate the DC offset effect from the disturbed supply voltage unlike second order generalised integrator (SOGI) control whose performance suffers under distorted supply conditions. Therefore, unit voltage templates are purely sinusoidal and used to extract the reference source current to generate the pulses for VSC. The proposed control is utilized to control the total harmonics distortion in the supply current, load balancing at the generator terminal, reactive power compensation and zero voltage and frequency regulation at the generator end. The entire system is developed in MATLAB simulink prototype for simulation study. The results obtained are compared with the existing SOGI control and found that the proposed control algorithms on this system has performed better in terms of dynamics voltage and frequency response with less steady state error.

Author Keywords: total harmonics distortion and steady state error

articleTitle: Brushless DC Hub Motor Drive Control for Electric Vehicle Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Global warming, air pollution and sound pollution are major environmental problems faced by today's world. Environmental pollution and increasing cost of fuels had led to the importance of using alternate sources for transportation since Internal combustion (IC) engine vehicles carries more than 40% of the pollution. Battery electric vehicles (BEV) is an alternative which received high attention in transportation industry. This paper focus on the control of Brushless DC (BLDC) motor which is used to drive the Electric two-wheeler. Hardware implementation of the motor is developed and an Atmega 328 microcontroller is utilized to control the motor which is provides a speed control with current commutation. A 60V, 1000W BLDC hub Motor is used to meet the drive requirements. The mathematical modeling of BLDC motor is discussed with the mathematical equations. MATLAB Simulation is developed, and the closed loop speed control is done in Simulink. PWM pulses generated from the MCU as per the commutation sequence and loaded to control the switches of 3-phase inverter and in response to the driver inputs (start/stop, accelerator, brake) the motor speeds are dynamically varied.

articleTitle: Significance of IoT in India’s E-Medical Framework: A study
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: India well known as the `Republic of India' is a nation in South Asia and the seventh in rank among biggest country area wise, the second-most populated country. As the population increasing and progress has been affected by series of diseases; a continuous rise in communicable diseases and a gush in non-communicable. Medicinal services consists of emergency clinics, restorative gadgets, clinical preliminaries, redistributing, telemedicine, medical tourism, medical coverage, and medical equipment. In India, there is one doctor for every 1,457 people as per the country's current population estimate of 1.35 billion, which is lower than the World Health Organization norm of 1:1000, the government has informed Parliament (July 2019). Especially in rural India condition are more worrying so IoT may play an important role for delivering better medical services using e-medical framework. The foremost scope is to provide an ample summary of open problems and challenges to be resolved by future analysis. In this paper we offer specific visions into specific rising ideas so as to facilitate future analysis of benefits of e-medical services in India.

articleTitle: Fault Location in Underground Cable System Using optimization Technique
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: This paper presents a way for endeavoring cable fault distance location by using an optimizing technique. The proposed scheme aims to model and test the two popular cable fault location methods i.e. Murray and Varley loop. The modelling of the bridge circuits of Murray and Varley loop are implemented in MATLAB environment. Using optimization algorithms, both implemented platforms of Murray and Varley loop test, locate the earth faults and short circuit fault in underground cables accurately. The proposed platforms are useful to study the concept of optimization techniques in combination with the conventional cable fault location methods. Here Box's evolutionary multivariable optimization technique is used for calculating two resistance variable function of the Murray Loop and Bisection Method which converges to a single optimum root is used for calculating single resistance variable of the Varley Loop for balancing the bridge circuit. The simulation results confirm that the proposed scheme assess the fault location with minimum error and is unaffected to variation in fault distance, fault resistance, and fault inception angle.

articleTitle: A Literature Review on Application of Machine Learning Techniques in Pancreas Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Pancreas segmentation provide radiologically and clinically significant information for diagnosing diseases related to pancreas. Moreover, it also helps to plan pancreatic surgery. Pancreas segmentation is a challenging task due to very high shape and volume variability of the pancreas among different patients. In this paper, we have reviewed machine learning and deep learning-based approaches applied by various researchers for pancreas segmentation. These algorithms have a mean Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) of 78.35% with maximum and minimum DSC as 89.7% and 56.46% respectively. The availability of better computation power and large datasets will further enhance the performance of pancreas segmentation and related tasks. The approaches presented in this paper can be easily modified to the multi organ segmentation methods by changing the loss function. The study revealed the challenge of quantizing network while maintaining performance accuracy.

articleTitle: Operation and control of Synchronverter technique in grid connected and intentional islanding modes for AC micro grids
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: The modern power system advances to an inverter dominant system from the synchronous machine-based system due to the penetration of Renewable energy sources. When these inverter dominant systems are integrated with the grid, they can lead to frequency instability. Hence the inverter with the virtual inertia control algorithms has been implemented so that it appears like the synchronous generator to the grid. Also the islanding mode for the stand-alone operation or when the main grid fails due to disturbance is an important case that should be considered in a micro-grid. This paper presents one such virtual synchronous machine (VSM) the scheme in both grid-connected mode and intentional islanding mode of operation and are verified. The mathematical modeling is done to verify theoretical performance of the techniques and simulations are carried out in MATLAB Simulink environment.

articleTitle: Model Order Reduction of Fixed Coefficient System with and without PID controller
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Present paper discuses about model order reduction by using mixed method for a fixed coefficient system. In this method, the reduced order model coefficients of denominator is obtained by Stability equation method, whereas numerator coefficients are obtained by optimization method. Then, a PID controller is designed by Particle Swarm optimization (PSO) for reduced model and that controller can be implemented to original higher order system without changes of the original and reduced system responses. By using numerical example the proposed method is well illustrated.

articleTitle: Detection and Location Estimation of Object in Unmanned Aerial Vehicle using Single Camera and GPS
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: It is important for an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) to detect any object in its view. This enables the UAV to locate the object with respect to itself and is required for locking and tracking the object. Object detection and location estimation makes the UAV capable of manipulating the environment as well as to follow the target. In the present work, object detection has been carried out using You Only Look Once (YOLO) to detect the object in the image stream of the Robot Operating System (ROS) bag file. The GPS information of the UAV is used to further calculate the GPS coordinates of the object. The images are acquired using a single monocular camera.

articleTitle: Design of Push-Pull FlybackConverter interfaced with Solar PV System
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: The problem of electrification is still prevailing in many parts of India. The non-electrified rural areas can be fed power by the use of standalone system photovoltaic system. The output of PV array mainly depends on the physical conditions like irradiation and temperature. Therefore, a robust converter is required which can operate under variable input conditions. Flyback converter is widely used in the industrial switched mode power supply (SMPS) applications because of its isolated voltage output, low cost and high efficiency. In the present work, the push - pull flyback converter interfaced with solar PV system for domestic and small-scale industrial applications has been designed. The design has been simulated with fixed and variable irradiation inputs to the PV array in the MATLAB/SIMULINK environment.

articleTitle: Towards classification of email through selection of informative features
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Dodging spam filters by spammers has become a serious issue in classifying emails as spam or ham. An extremely high dimensionality of emails sent/received is one of the major characteristic of email classification. To train a classifier without decreasing its capability of prediction is important in classification of emails. Feature selection method plays an important role in identifying most relevant features to classify emails by inventing new techniques. The features are extracted based on the relationship established between the words of various classes and it helps to increase the probability of the words to represent informative features. The words can be either of positive or negative in nature. In this paper, relationship among the words present in subject and content of emails has been used to determine the nature of the word and then selected the most related words to form informative features from set of all words. These words are then used to generate the N-grams. Four different classifiers namely Decision tree, Multinomial Naive Bayes, Random Forest classifiers, Linear Support Vector Machine classifiers have been used to determine the performance of the selected N-Grams features. The experimental analysis has been performed over Ling-Spam email dataset.

articleTitle: Dimensionality Reduction on Hyperspectral Data Set
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Hyperspectral image data is a continuous succession of hundreds of narrow spectral bands (each 10 nm wide) collected over visible to infrared regions of the electromagnetic spectrum. These image data sets hold useful information in the form of a data cube, which can be noisy and redundant. Redundancy in these data sets can lead to sparseness, which is the cause of curse of dimensionality. Dimensionality reduction techniques resolve the problem of curse of dimensionality in the hyperspectral data set by extracting meaningful and compact information. In this paper, an attempt has been made to minimize the dimension of the hyperspectral data set by employing Principal component analysis (PCA), Singular value decomposition (SVD), and Independent component analysis (ICA) techniques for the extraction of spatial features. The extracted spatial and spectral features are classified using the Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier. The classification result shows that with the increase in the number of dimensionalities, classification accuracy starts to decrease.

articleTitle: Application of Internet of Things: Last meter smart grid and smart energy efficient system
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Internet of things is one of the rapidly growing innovations in the field of telecommunication. The main purpose of the correspondence and collaboration among things, mans and objects is to fulfill the objective set to them as an amalgamated entity. Nowadays, electricity is the Minimum requirement of a community for a decent standard of life. Consumption of energy is increasing exponentially paving the manner for energy effective technologies and revealing limited renewable energy sources. To overcome these problems, bi-functional system is proposed in which last meter smart grid and energy efficient system in-home prototype is recommended. Traditional power grid are being revolutionized to smart grid in order to overcome obstacles such as uni-directional flow of energy and information, wastage of energy, authenticity and security. The classical grid model is mainly “distributedcentric” rather than “consumer centric”. To deal with these problems this paper proposes a comprehensive architecture and implementation of “last meter smart grid”-a part of smart grid situated at end user premises-embedded in iot platform and also proposes a system for continuous monitoring of electrical appliances. The proposed system can also provide provision of decreasing the energy wastage by incessantly observing the electrical appliances based on completely different sensors input.

articleTitle: Study on factors affecting distance protection scheme of UPFC compensated transmission lines
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: The advancements of technology in present time have led a steep rise in power consumption and its demand. To meet the everlasting growth of power demand, electric utilities are opting for capacity expansions and modernization of existing networks. Incorporation of flexible ac transmission systems (FACTS) devices into existing system is one of preferred choices of modernization because this step enhances the transmission line capacity of the existing network thus, preventing the utilities to go for capacity expansions. Additionally, FACTS devices increase the power quality and reliability of the system. Unified power flow controller (UPFC) is most preferred FACTS device due to its versatility in regulating voltage and power transfer. However, the incorporation of FACTS devices in the transmission system may hamper the protection system. In several studies, it is found that FACTS devices affect the coordination of protective relays resulting in either underreaching or overreaching of the relays. Thus, this paper presents study of different factors which affect the distance protection scheme of UPFC employed lines. In this event, the considered factors are installation point of UPFC, operating modes of UPFC, location of fault, different fault resistances, different fault inception angles, different type of faults and external faults. MATLAB environment is chosen as the simulation platform for all simulation studies.

articleTitle: A Secure Block Operation based Bit-plane Image Encryption using Chaotic Maps
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: This paper proposes a scheme for image encryption based on fixed block operations of size $2\times 2$. The proposed scheme encrypts images of any sizes. This technique addresses the problem of executing fixed block based permutations and diffusions in variable-sized images. For fixed block size based operation, the proposed method initially generates eight bit-planes and then combines bit-planes into two groups, where each group has four bit-planes. The combined bit-planes are then divided into blocks of size $2\times 2$. Then the array of two groups of blocks are permuted by using two different Piece-wise Linear Chaotic Map (PWLCM) systems independently. After block permutation, the block diffusion (bit-XOR) is performed by using a key block generated by another PWLCM system. Finally, the diffused blocks are combined to generate a cipher image, which is same size of original image. Apart from that, the proposed algorithm uses the plaintext related keys to resist the ciphertext against the major type of attacks known as “known-plaintext attack (KPA)” and “chosen-plaintext attack (CPA) The computer simulations show the best performance of the algorithm on encryption of images of variable sizes. The security evaluation ensures that the algorithm proposed is resistive to several widely used attacks.

articleTitle: Improved Aircraft Performance using Simple Pitch Control
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Stability and control are composite for an aircraft. Three basic control movements of the aircraft are Pitch, Roll and Yaw where Pitch enables a plane to descend or climb. The pitching movement control is paramount to ensure the stability of the aircraft and intrinsic safety of passengers. This paper intends to explore few control schemes for the aircraft pitch control system. Conventional PID controller and Fuzzy tuned PID are probed and interpreted through the simulation results obtained using MATLAB. The qualified assessment of aforesaid methods based on time response specifications is cited in the paper. Further the robustness analysis has also been included. The results from the proposed control have been giving improved performance of aircraft, in comparison to methods from literature.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Small Signal Modeling of the DC/DC Converters with CDM Controller Design
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: In this paper the DC/DC buck, boost and buck boost converters mathematical models are developed by average state space technique. Since the converters possess nonlinear and time variant characteristics, so to linearize them and stabilize the output voltages their small signal models have been developed using the average state space models. These small signal models are useful to derive voltage and current transfer functions and hence easy to design controllers to obtain the regulated output voltage. This paper pay attention on the step by step development of the small signal models for all the converters and also the design of dual loop CDM controllers for buck boost converter to attain desired voltage at output. The output response curve settles down fast with negligible overshoot and steady state error.

articleTitle: Heuristic Optimization based Controller Design for Voltage Regulation in Small Hydropower Plant
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Renewable energy sources such as hydropower, solar energy, wind power, etc. are being utilized throughout the world due to their eco-friendliness, cleanliness and costeffectiveness nature. Hydropower plant especially small hydropower plants are progressively installed in water distribution network, because of its several advantages over large hydropower plant. In the present paper, Small hydropower plant uses generalized PID controllers in its governor and excitation system to regulate terminal voltage of the synchronous generator against any disturbance. Thus, for voltage regulation and the apt operation of controllers, controllers have been tuned using PSO algorithm along with relatively new techniques such as PIO and JAYA algorithm for minimization of various integral performance indices in MATLAB & Simulink environment.

Author Keywords: Fractional Order Proportional Integral Derivative Controller (FOPID) Controller

articleTitle: Functional and Anatomical Image Fusion based on Texture Energy Measures in NSST Domain
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: The fused functional and anatomical image provides additional diagnostic information essential for precise diagnosis of disease and treatment planning. This work focused on obtaining a fused image that presents functional and anatomical information without loss and without distortion. We employed YIQ color model for functional information retention. The anatomical details are preserved through the use of texture energy measures in nonsubsampled shearlet transform (NSST) domain. The proposed method is tested on a dataset consisting of Single Photon Emission Computed Tomography (SPECT) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) images of brain tumor cases. Along with visual analysis, the fused images are quantitatively evaluated with five image fusion quality metrics.

articleTitle: Cascaded H-Bridge MLI based Grid Connected Cell Level Battery Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: This paper proposes a combination of cell-level energy processing and a Cascaded H-Bridge Multilevel Inverter (CHBMLI) for medium voltage, grid connected, battery energy storage systems. One isolated converter (Dual Active Bridge DC-DC Converter) manages each cell in the Battery Module, and the combination of Battery module and converter modules are cascaded to get the multi-level ac output voltage. The operating principle and control design of cell level isolated converter with double frequency ripple power, and the control strategy of the CHBMLI are presented. The performance of the battery cell level CHBMLI system with a 9-level inverter at small scale power level is validated through the simulations in MATLAB<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">®</sup>/SIMULINK<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">®</sup> software. The configuration holds promise for improving the performance and reliability of the battery modules at the cell level while also providing cell level galvanic isolation and high ac voltage.

articleTitle: Modified Sine Triangle Approach For 30-Degree Split Clamp Pulse Width Modulation For Three Phase Voltage Source Inverter
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Conventional Space Vector Pulse Width Modulation (CSVPWM) uses conventional switching sequence in which near about 15 percent increment can be obtained in voltages compared to Sine Pulse Width Modulation (SPWM). But this method can be further modified into other advanced bus clamping methods called as Bus Clamping Pulse Width Modulation (BCPWM). One of those bus clamping methods is 30-Degree Split Clamp PWM method. It has all the advantages of Conventional Space Vector Pulse Width Modulation (CSVPWM) and it eliminates some disadvantages of traditional technique. In CSVPWM there are only 6 sectors and in 30Degree Split Clamping PWM these 6 sectors are further divided into sub-sectors (12) which allows for a new switching pattern. One of the major disadvantages of 3 phase CSVPWM is that the lower order harmonics of voltages and currents are comparably higher with respect to 30-Degree Split Clamp PWM. Filters can be easily designed for 30-Degree Split Clamp PWM. Even the switching losses are high in case of CSVPWM as switching occurs when the current is maximum depending on the power factor.

articleTitle: Investigation of Layered Separators for Improved Performance of Supercapacitors
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: With advancement in technology and rising population, the demand for energy is increasing day by day. Renewable energy is solution as of now. To use renewable energy on a commercial scale, energy storage is important. The latest device for energy storage which can be used is supercapacitors and it is required to be used along with a fuel cell or battery. Electrode electrolyte research is common for supercapacitor but very less research was found pertaining to separator. This paper presents the study related to layered separators consisting of polyethylene and seven different separators, viz gauntlet, base paper, PVC, paper, fiber glass absorbent glass mat, soft fiber glass absorbent glass mat and auto fiber glass. Focus was on layered separators which have hardly being studied. Some good combinations of layered separators are suggested based on “Separator index” a new term suggested in this paper for selection of separators.

articleTitle: Review On IoT Enabled Smart Cities in India
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: In the year 2015, the newly elected Political-party of India started the smart-cities project. The main purpose of enlightening the governance is corporal and governmental structures and facilities (e.g. constructions of buildings, roads, and power supplies, etc.) dearth that outbreak Indian cities. The Operation emphatically, conditions that there is no standard definition of a `smart city' and indicates immeasurable freedom for cities to self-define their thoughtful of `smart-ness'. It is also the innovative footstep by the Indian Government to construct smart-cities in India to permit monetary development and eminence people's life by permitting confined expansion and using smart technologies to make it's resident's life healthier. For this purpose, the government of India firstly covering five years plan for hundreds of cities in India. After five years the evaluation process takes care by the MoUD and fascinating the existence of smart cities criteria and also will apply outside of the cities. This paper presented the challenges on the operation, implementation strategy and achieving objectives of smart cities in India.

articleTitle: Protection of Wind Park Incorporated Series Compensated Transmission Line Using DMWT
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: In this study, the discrete Meyer wavelet transform (DMWT) is exploited for the recognition of faults and categorization of faulted phase in the wind park incorporated series compensated transmission line (WPISCTL). The DMWT is immensely inspected using the simulation model of the WPISCTL. The three-phase fault currents measured by the transducers linked at the generator-bus of the power system network are inserted to the proposed DMWT-based design for fault recognition and faulted phase categorization. The recognition of fault and categorization of faulted phase are studied with great appropriateness.

Author Keywords: wind park incorporated series compensated transmission line

articleTitle: Classification and Detection of Heart Rhythm Irregularities using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Accurate detection of arrhythmias is critical to patient well-being in clinical settings because the readings usually reflect acute and chronic cardiac problems. Because of variability between individuals and unavoidable noise, this is known to be a difficult problem even for human experts. This paper explores the use of deep neural networks for the task of classifying ECG recordings using recurrent and residual architectures. The proposed method tested on ECG dataset of 162 patients’ readings that consist of three classes including normal sinus rhythm, cardiac arrhythmia and congestive heart failure. Results shows that proposed LSTM method having 4 hidden layers and optimization function as Adam gives maximum accuracy of 99.12% in comparison to other methods.

Index Terms: Heart Failure With Reduced Ejection Fraction

articleTitle: Digital Watermarking Technique using Dual Tree Complex Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: With the growing advent of data in day to day life, prevention of illegal data distribution is becoming very important. Digital watermarking is an effective way of ensuring the data is not distributed illegally and its being used effectively to stop the malpractices. Hence, the watermark needs to be imperceptible as well as robust from attacks like rotation, cropping and compression. We propose a method of digital watermarking using a novel technique of Dual Tree- Complex Wavelet Transform. The watermark is embedded into the Chrominance levels by converting the RGB image into YUV channels. This is done because the chrominance levels are less perceptible to the human visual system. A perceptual mask is generated using a predefined low pass filter, which adds to the imperceptibility of the watermark. During the watermark extraction process, the inverse of the perceptual mask generated is used. By using DTCWT it is possible to exploit features like directionality and shift invariance which is not possible in other frequency domain techniques like DWT, DCT and DFT.

articleTitle: Cryptanalysis and Enhancement of Harn-Lin’s Secret Sharing Scheme with Cheating Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Deployment of secrecy techniques is unquestionably necessitous for everyday communication over the unbarred and insecure network, as sensitive information craves bulwark from sliding into wrong whereabouts. Key negotiations using secret sharing methods, is an effectual and trenchant way to procure secrecy while transmitting information over the open internet. The secret keys so obtained, can be made use of, in encryption/decryption purposes. Methods like (t, n) threshold based, allow secret keys to be generated by combining split shares, where an individual split share have no value of its own. Existence of adversaries complicates matters by easily fooling honest participants. We identified unwanted features in Harn-Lin's secret sharing method, as extra participants/outsiders not belonging to a particular group, gets involved in secrecy reconstruction, a displeasing idiosyncrasy. Our proposed improvements over it for efficient threshold based secret sharing procedure with cheating detection is by effective inclusion of only a single extra share, however, from the dealer. Our work ensures outsiders do not mingle in group based secret key formations and also discuss ways to identify distinct cheaters.

articleTitle: Topological Overview of Single-Inductor based Multiple-Output Channel LED Driver
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Recently, the usage of light-emitting diode (LED) have grabbed the market and come into the spotlight due to their key advantages such as low energy consumption, compact size and fast switching. LED works on the constant current and for this purpose numerous LED driver circuits have been proposed in state of art. Among them, a single inductor based multi output (SIMO) driver circuit has drawn attention due to multiple channel output, less component count and compact size. This paper aims to review several single inductor based LED driver circuits and compared with their counter parts in aspects of architecture, integration, operation and control scheme of the driver circuit. Further, the control strategy and designing of SIMO based LED driver based circuit has been generalized. The major pros and cons have been summarized in this paper.

articleTitle: Adversarial Auto-encoders for Image Generation from standard EEG features
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: New deep-learning-based classification and generative models have recently found applications in EEG and fMRI-based brain studies. In this manuscript, we propose a simple solution of finding feature representations of EEG signals using statistical analysis which can be used for classification of stimuli in real time. Also, we use a deep generative model called adversarial auto-encoder (AAE) and attempt to reconstruct the stimuli back from these features. The EEG data was recorded from visual stimuli of subjects who were shown images from the ImageNet dataset and the proposed model aims to reconstruct images directly from the EEG feature manifold. Classification accuracy of 90% was achieved for the classification of images based on EEG features. Qualitative evaluation of the reconstructed images demonstrates the efficacy of our experimental model. The models can be trained on a PC with classification in real time.

articleTitle: Analysis and Testing of Dual Axis Solar Tracker for a Standalone PV System
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: To sustain life in earth we need considerable amount of energy. For our body it is given by food we eat but we also need energy for machines and equipment for them to work. Since non-renewable source of energy is exhaustible in nature so nowadays we move towards renewable source of energy. One of the major sources of renewable energy is sun. Today we are using only a small amount of solar energy by using solar cells. These solar cells are placed at fixed position so amount is limited. To increase the amount of energy we receive we use solar tracker. Solar tracker is the device used to follow the sun. In this paper we deal with dual axis solar tracker with real time tracking technology. By this method we can increase the solar energy production up to 45%.

articleTitle: Formalization of UML Class Diagram Using Colored Petri Nets
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: UML Diagrams has become a standard way of visualizing in designing any system. Among several UML diagrams, Class diagram plays a crucial role in defining the attributes and methods for any module. The UML Diagrams uses the concepts of object oriented modeling. In object oriented modelling both precision and details are needed at the same time which requires proper description of the constraints. In Object Oriented Modelling (OOM) the Object Constraint Language (OCL) is being used to design invariants (constraints). OCL brings additional precision to analysis and design model. System's behavior and its constraints need to be verified to ensure the preciseness of the modelled system. The computation of preciseness and correctness of OCL is necessary to ensure the user requirements and their satisfaction. This paper deals with the concept of validating the class diagram associated with OCL constraints using a formal method i.e., Colored Petri Nets (CPN). The case for elevator problem illustrates effectiveness of modelling.

articleTitle: Computer Vision Based Energy Monitoring System using Meter Image Capturing System (MICAPS)
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: In the era of smart grid, extraction of data from meters is the primary step. Conventionally data extraction from non-communicable meters are done manually. In order to provide complete smart solutions to the customers the utilities are planning for a mass roll out smart meters which is costly. Approximately |3000 to |4000 is required for replacing a noncommunicable meter to communicable meter and also requires to hamper the existing infrastructure. In this context this paper proposes a meter image capturing system (MICAPS). MICAPS is a image based technique for extraction of data. MICAPS is formed by integrating raspberry pi with raspberry pi camera. Python code is used to configure the camera and take the images and send it to cloud. This image is a seven segment display. In order to convert a seven segment display to text a computer vision optical recognition algorithm is used. The overall cost of the MICAPS is |4000 with which it is possible to monitor minimum 2 meters. One more advantage with MICAPS system is that remotely the operator will be able to change the granularity of the data based on the required. Thus this MICAPS will help in monitoring the energy in a community based distribution networks.

articleTitle: Breast cancer detection and validation using dual modality imaging
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Early detection of malignancy is important in order to reduce morbidity and mortality rate. However, existing approaches are based on a single modality having limited performance. Hence, the key objective of this study is detection and validation of breast cancer images using multimodality approach by combining both ultrasonography and mammography. Further, we investigate a particular segmentation approach that can accurately detect breast lesions using a dual-modality system. Three popular techniques i.e. Fuzzy-c-Means (FCM), and K-means (KM) and DPSO (Darwinian Particle swarm optimization) are experimented and evaluated for detecting lesions using combined ultrasonography and mammography. Performance measures such as the area of breast mass lesions, Jaccard Index (JI) and Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) have been used for the evaluation of the proposed dual modality breast cancer detection model. The results show that out of the implemented techniques, FCM outperformed others in detecting the lesion on both ultrasonography and mammography images with JI: highest average value (0.748) and lowest SD (0.124), DSC: highest average value (0.851) and lowest SD (0.084) and segmentation accuracy: highest average value (0.92) and lowest SD (0.074).

articleTitle: Laboratory Investigation of Photovoltaic Panel Performance Under the Shaded Condition
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: The most encouraging use of solar energy is its conversion into electrical energy by using solar photovoltaic (PV) panel. The performance of solar-based PV panel is undoubtedly influenced by the quantity of solar radiation, which is reaching on the panel surface. The occurrence of shading over the panel surface is a vital environmental phenomenon which affects the penetration of solar radiation to reach the overall surface area of photovoltaic cells. The shading on PV panels may happen due to trees, the formation of mists, accumulation of dirt elements on the panel surface, close by long-standing structures, shadows of different panels in its region, neighbouring structures and so on. This paper is mainly focused on the study of shading impact on the panel performance. Further, this paper also observed the influence of shading on the variation of surface temperature of the PV panel. The present study shown a significant reduction of 41.40% in the maximum power output (Pmax) of the panel due to 25% shading strength of the single cell in the panel. Moreover, it was also observed that the increase in the percentage shading strength over the panel surface shifts the maximum power point (MPP), of the panel characteristics, towards the lower output voltage, which affects the effective operation of the charge controller. Further, it was seen that the shading impact degrades the performance of the panel as well as in charge of the rise of the surface temperature of the panel. In the present investigation, it was observed that the temperature of the unshaded cell rises at the rate of 1.753%, due to the shading phenomena over the panel surface.

articleTitle: Self-balanced Modular Multilevel DC-DC converter for High Conversion Ratio
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Now a day, modular multilevel converters (MMC) are used for high power applications in the form of various standard and customized products. The paper presents a transformer less MMC with superior and advanced conversion ratio for higher dc-dc power conversion. This converter can be utilized mutually for both the Medium Voltage Direct Current (MVDC) transmission systems and High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) transmission systems. The remarkable features of MMC is modular design, scalability, reliability, tolerance of failures, larger step up and step down ratio and lowers filtering requirements. The MMC idea connects N low voltage sub-modules in sequence to produce a high voltage output. Thus there is no complex control algorithm necessary to stabilize or balance the voltages in every sub-module. Sequential connection of Half bridge sub modules (HB-SMs) capacitors ensure that the configuration is in self-balanced. Analysis of the converter in open loop configuration is investigated and does not require closed loop control technique. The conversion ratio of 1:10 is demonstrated in the simulation.

articleTitle: Survey of Symmetric and Asymmetric Key Management Schemes in the context of IoT based Healthcare System
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) based real-time health monitoring system gains the attention of the researchers as well as the business sectors. This service turns out to be a blessing to the patients as well as the health care professionals. However, without data security, the practical implementation of this vital healthcare service is not feasible. The sensitive nature of the patient's healthcare data is very crucial and the compromise of such data may compromise one's life. Therefore, in any IoT based healthcare system, data security is the vital issue. In this direction of IoT based healthcare system, this paper presents a survey of symmetric and asymmetric key management schemes. Considering the cryptographic key (symmetric or asymmetric), we have discussed the relevant studies within a time period of 6 years. A comparison of these schemes is presented with respect to the security features and simultaneously described the pros and cons of the respected schemes.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of Multiple Input Converter
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Multi input converters (MICs) emerged as an alternative to the conventional single input DC-DC converters and are widely used for integrating renewable energy sources. MIC topologies have evolved and are still evolving for different applications. The state of art reported different topologies, however, a limited literature details about the performance and its life time under different operating conditions. The estimation of current state of health and life time remaining helps to reduce the maintenance cost and gives an idea on suitability for real time implementation. In this regard, this paper aims to carry out the analysis of reliability for a MIC which possesses simple and modular structure and provides high control flexibility. The estimation procedure adopted could be used to estimate the reliability of any power converter. Further, the effect of parametric variation of the components used on reliability has also been discussed.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Cascaded H-bridge Multilevel Inverter by DWPT Multi resolution and ANN
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Fault diagnosis of multilevel inverters (MLIs) is main concern to the industries in recent era to improve the reliability of system. In this regard, a two stage fault diagnosis of switch fault in cascaded H-bridge multilevel inverter (CHBMLI) with phase shift pulse width modulation has been implemented in this paper. In the first stage discrete wavelet packet transform (DWPT) multi resolution extracts the features of load voltage. It decomposes approximation as well as detail coefficients of the signal to extract features like fundamental peak, mean and standard deviation (STD) for pattern recognition. It gives better frequency resolution over other techniques by effectively decomposing coefficients. In the later stage, the features extracted from DWPT train the ANN. Thus trained ANN is tested for pattern recognition during normal and fault conditions. Scaled conjugate gradient back propagation method is used to ANN training. Thus tested ANN classifies the switch fault accurately. This method efficiently diagnosis the switch faults under different load conditions. Performance of fault diagnosis method is verified using MATLAB simulation.

articleTitle: Algorithm Based on Combined Features of Stockwell Transform and Hilbert Transform for Detection of Transmission Line Faults with Dynamic Load
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: An approach which is supported by combination of obtained with the help of Stockwell Transform (ST) and Hilbert Transform (HT) has been introduced in this paper for recognition of different nature of faults observed on transmission line with availability of dynamic load (DL). Faults including line ground (LG), line to line (LL), two lines to ground (LLG), and all the three phases to grounds (LLLG) are effectively detected in the presence of dynamic load by the use of proposed algorithm. A fault index based median of output matrix of decomposition of current using the ST and absolute output values calculated from decomposition of current using the HT is introduced for identification of faults and discrimination of different faults observed on transmission line from each other. Performance of the algorithm has been evaluated with the help of MATLAB software.

articleTitle: Power Quality Improvement by Optimum Gain controlled SAPF
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Now-a-days active power filters (APFs) became popular for harmonics mitigation and compensation of reactive power generated by non-linear power electronics load devices. This paper illustrates modeling and simulation of three-phase and three-wire shunt active power filters (SAPF). The active power filters (APF) model consist a three-leg voltage source inverter (VSI) having a common DC-link capacitor. For switching pulse generation of VSI hysteresis band pulse width modulation (PWM) based current controller is used. Reference current generation is important part of controlling of APFs, since any inaccuracy in current references generation results incorrect compensation. Instantaneous reactive power (IRPT) theory is used for current references estimation for various manually selected gains of PI-controller and their results are analyzed to get the optimum gains for minimum harmonics & Total Harmonics Distortion (THD). This technique is implemented in MATLAB/Simulink environment & harmonics determining parameter, Total Harmonics Distortion (THD) is calculated and compared for different manually selected values of gains of PI-controller.

articleTitle: Techniques used for the LVRT ability enhancement for DFIG connected system
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: In modern power systems in many countries, the presence of sustainable power sources is expanding day by day. In integrated power system of modern era, wind generators also play a major role. A higher percentage of wind generators in unusual situations impact the intermittent actions of the entire grid. Doubly fed wind energy conversion generator (DFIG-WECS) is the generator form that is primarily regulated but then again highly vulnerable to grid voltage disturbance. New norms related to grid made it mandatory for wind farms of large rating to continue operated with the grid for a short period during the abnormal voltage situation owing to any failure or unusual circumstance. This generator's capacity to stay attached to the device under unusual voltage situations is known low voltage ride through of generator. This paper remarks the Grid norms proposed by IWGC for wind generator LVRT and reviews some important work that researchers have done in recent years to improve DFIG-WECS' LVRT capacity.

Author Keywords: Doubly fed wind energy conversion induction generator (DFIG-WECS)

articleTitle: Modelling of a smart hybrid water-power system for freshwater and energy supply network
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: This research work presents an opportunity of trading the most precious of all-natural resources “the water” in the world into the central of the Africa context. Democratic Republic of Congo (DR Congo) is one of the vast countries in Africa that has an extensive freshwater resource, which could supply water to some desert countries on the African continent such as Chad. The demographic and the dry area of Chad country are increasing. Therefore, it is found that, as a country in central of Africa, it could be supplied by Congo River if the connection point is optimal selected before and/or after the electrical power dam sectors in DR Congo, and if this is well coordinated with environmental and economic policies. It is also found that the long-distance of water transportation needs several hydro storage systems to compensate water loss while ensuring the auto power supply of the network.

articleTitle: Effectiveness of the fractal dimension based classification methods for fractal compression of medical images
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Medica1 imaging modalities for different diseases need to be store for accurate and fast quantitative assessment in future reference of the patients. Also, store these medical images in compressed form still a challenging task by maintaining high diagnostic quality. For the higher compression ratio, the reconstructed image quality degrades due to the blocky artifact during the reconstruction process. This paper used the fractal dimension based texture complexity to efficiently classified the domain blocks and reduced the encoding time for the fractal image compression to compress the medical images. The fractal dimension can reduce the blocking artifact by efficiently identifying and separating the complex and smooth blocks. This paper mainly discusses the selection of suitable fractal dimension approach by comparison of domain and range blocks classification using support vector machine, fuzzy c-means and k-means classification approaches.

articleTitle: Damping of Power System Oscillations Using GA and GOA Optimized SSSC Based Controller
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Growth of energy sector is one of the major factors in empowering the nation. And strengthening of power system is done by enhancing system reliability, security and quality. The main area to focus on is stability of the power system as it maintains the voltage and frequency of the system to a desired level. This paper presents a Single Machine Infinite Bus system with a Static Synchronous Series Compensator (SSSC) based supplementary damping controller in addition with PSS (Power System Stabilizer). The most favorable values of the SSSC based supplementary controller is determined using Genetic Algorithm and Grasshopper optimization Algorithm and comparison of both the optimization techniques is made. The coordinated design of controllers, thus formed is studied considering different fault conditions and system response against these fault conditions are analyzed.

articleTitle: Modelling of Twin Rotor MIMO System using Differential Evolution with Success-based Parameter Adaptation
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: An efficient evolutionary optimization technique has been employed for modelling of a twin rotor MIMO (multi-input-multi-output) system, using black box system identification approach. The modelling problem has been framed as an optimization problem by formulating suitable objective functions. The optimization algorithm aims at determining the optimal set of model parameters by minimizing the deviation between experimental and model data. A comparative analysis has been carried out duly supported by extensive experimentation and simulation results.

articleTitle: Moth Swarm Algorithm based cascade PI-PD controller for frequency regulation of distributed power generation system with electric vehicle
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: The current paper depicts a Moth Swarm Algorithm (MSA) for frequency regulation of Distributed Power Generation System (DPGS) using cascade PI-PD controller. The DGPS includes the renewable power generator such as wind, solar photovoltaic and storage devices like flywheel, battery along with electric vehicles. The suggested cascade PI-PD and PID controller gains are tuned by MSA technique. Here, the mastery of the proposed MSA tuned cascade PI-PD controller over conventional PID controller is established with respect to effectiveness for frequency regulation.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Area and Power Optimised SRAM Cell for High-speed Processor
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: The basic 6T Static random access memory (SRAM) cell experience from relatively high static and total power loss problem, to solve this 8T, NC cells were designed. But this all consume more area as well as delay. Hence in this paper, 5T SRAM cell proposed and checked by Monte Carlo Simulation. The area reduced by 20.3%, 20.42%, and 7.82% compared to NC, 8T, and 6T cell respectively. The total power is reduced by 95.05%, 94.2%, and 96.6% compared to NC,8T, and 6T. Similarly, static power is diminished by 57.8%,75.8%, and 79.9% compared to NC, 8T, and 6T. Speed of proposed cell improved by 52.3%, 47.6%, and 53.9% compared to NC, 8T, and 6T respectively with acceptable stability. Finally, all the cells are also checked by Monte Carlo Simulation under 45 nm CMOS Technology.

articleTitle: Simulation for Fault Forbearance Operation for Three-Phase Three-level H-Bridge Multilevel Inverter by Space Vector Modulation technique
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: This paper represents the fault tolerance technique of three-phase three-level H-Bridge Multilevel inverter. Near about equal output voltages are generated in single fault and pre-fault conditions. Regardless of the appearance of fault location and its class, three-phase balanced voltage is generated with its peak amplitude. The auxiliary module is connected which is voltage source two-level inverter along with a dc capacitive link. After fault detection, the auxiliary module gets activated and the capacitor charging and discharging starts and then the voltage across the auxiliary module is constant and the reference Vector is synchronized. The validation of the proposed technique is affirmed by simulations on a three-level H-Bridge for three-phase Inverters.

articleTitle: Model Order Reduction by Teaching Learning Based Optimization and FOPID Controller Designing
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Reduced order systems, in comparison with original higher order systems make the topic of model reduction a subject of big importance as it provides a simpler system which is easy to be studied and used further for controller designing. To reduce the system Teaching learning based technique has been used in this paper. This method provides a stable reduced system for a stable original model. The technique is applied on the system such that the parameters of reduced system is optimized to obtain minimum error between the original and reduced order system. In this paper integral squared error (ISE) between the step response of original and reduced model is minimized. The performance of reduced order system has been analysed by step response and bode plot. A comparison has been provided based on ISE for different existing reduction methods. Robust and efficient performing systems are obtained by Fractional-order control (FOC) systems which is obtained by fine tuning of parameters. Fractional order Controllers are fractional-order differential equations. In this paper the reduced system's performance has been improved by fractional-order PID (FOPID) controller which is tuned by TLBO method. In expressions of percentage overshoot, rise time and settling time, FOPID controller gives best performance as compared with that of the PID controller.

articleTitle: Significance of texture feature in NIR face recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: The Face recognition is a unique challenging problem in the field of content-based image retrieval (CBIR) as the high level semantics of faces of many people are alike. In this case the algorithm needs to find the uniqueness in the individual's face image. This becomes more difficult with the NIR face recognition due to low resolution image quality. In this work our objective is to ascertain the significance of the texture feature in NIR face recognition. We proposed a NIR face recognition system using combined feature vector which consists of the S Sub-band of the SVD feature and the LBP texture feature of the original image. The performance of the proposed combined feature is compared with the global SVD feature's performance. In addition to the minimum distance classifier(MDC), we have also used the support vector machine(SVM) and k-nearest neighbour(KNN) classifiers for the analysis.

articleTitle: Transmission Line Protection Scheme Based on Combined Features of Stockwell Transform and Hilbert Transform
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: An algorithm using combined features of Stockwell Transform and the Hilbert Transform is introduced in this paper for detect faults to design and implement transmission line protection scheme. Transmission line faults like phase to ground (LG), double phase (LL), double phases to ground (LLG), and three phases to ground (LLLG) faults are effectively detected. Stockwell transform based median of current signal and Hilbert transform output absolute values are multiplied for extracting fault index. This index is implemented for detection as well as discrimination of different types of faults observed on power transmission line. Study is performed using MATLAB software in simulink scenario.

articleTitle: Optimum installed capacity of Coal Based Powei Plants cogitating Environment and Economic Aspects
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: Towards its commitment to climate change Government of India (GOI), being a part of Nationally Determined Contributions (NDC) has taken up an ambitious program of renewable energy sources to increase its capacity to 40% by the year 2030 without considering its implications on the overall power system. The installed capacity for base load intends to serve primarily the demand based on the minimum load requirements. This paper focuses mainly on computing the optimum installed capacity of thermal/coal based power plants considering the average hourly demand over the months of the year. To compute the optimum installed capacity of thermal/coal base power plants, based on the past trends three cases have been considered - lowest out of minimum of average hourly demand, lowest out of average of the average hourly demand and highest out of minimum of average hourly demand. The proposed methodology has been implemented on the average demand chart of state of Maharashtra, India for the year 2018. This mitigates the environmental impact to a reasonable extent and simultaneously makes these plants operate at their optimal levels with increased plant load factor and reduced energy losses thus reducing the overall cost of generation.

articleTitle: Transformer based Passive Neutral Current Compensation Techniques in Distributed Power Generation System
publicationTitle: 2020 First International Conference on Power, Control and Computing Technologies (ICPC2T)
abstract: The neutral current compensation is identified as a one of the major power quality issues in three phase four wire distributed power generation system working in off-grid mode.
